description: This file defines the QueueManager class responsible for managing Redis queues, including setup, registration, and retrieval of queues and related components in a server-side application using BullMQ and Express.

classes.name: QueueManager
classes.description: Singleton class managing Redis queues, including setup, registration, and access to specific queues and related components.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of QueueManager.

methods.name: registerQueue
methods.description: Registers a queue with a given name.

methods.name: getQueue
methods.description: Retrieves a registered queue by name.

methods.name: getPredictionQueueEventsProducer
methods.description: Returns the QueueEventsProducer for prediction queues.

methods.name: getBullBoardRouter
methods.description: Returns the Express router for Bull Board UI.

methods.name: getAllJobCounts
methods.description: Fetches job counts for all registered queues.

methods.name: setupAllQueues
methods.description: Initializes and registers prediction and upsert queues, and sets up Bull Board if serverAdapter is provided.
